sentence: This project studies how children learn about nature and ecosystems in their daily lives, from their own experiences and from adults.
This project builds numerical methods that use integral equations to solve physical problems involving waves, including sound in medical imaging.
This project builds an app that uses a phone or tablet camera to judge how likely an older adult is to fall and to coach exercises.
This project studies how a single-celled organism called Stentor coeruleus avoids and heals wounds.
This project tries to find out how forces in the bone marrow help a young red blood cell push out its nucleus.
This project builds a way to compress the messages that computers share while training large deep learning models.
This project designs small proteins called monobodies that can enter cells, using chemical crosslinking and a computer method based on deep learning.
This project studies how quantum effects such as entanglement can be used to build more secure encryption and ways to verify computations.
This project builds tools that turn uncertain space weather forecasts into risk information for the people who run satellites.
This project studies how fish and robotic swimmers change speed by coordinating muscle movement with sensing their own motion and the water flow.
This project designs a slim brain probe that uses light to carry the signals recorded from many neurons.
This project develops ways to make groups of robots and other autonomous agents follow safety rules and work reliably in the real world.
This project builds a framework that lets scientists and administrators write and enforce rules for who may share computing and data resources.
This project tries to find out whether satellite links can work as reliably in higher radio frequency bands as they do in lower ones.
This project builds a security framework that finds and blocks attacks on robots by modeling how their computer and physical parts depend on each other.
This project studies how easy digital identities that people control themselves are to use and builds a list of the communication protocols they need.
This project studies how common it is for plants and green algae to make transcripts that encode several proteins.
This project studies why systems of many quantum particles sometimes fail to settle into thermal equilibrium.
This project builds a system using augmented reality that uses pictures of a worksite to spot hazards and show simulated accidents.
